title: Philippines Marketplace Seller Health
thesis: On one governed platform, Snowflake turns daily seller activity from a synthetic Philippine online marketplace into order-integrity KPIs, 7-day order-cancellation risk per seller, return rate anomalies and AI answers that cite their sources.

persona.name: Andrea Villanueva
persona.role: Head of Marketplace Trust and Operations (fictional)

talking_points: 48 sellers ship from Quezon City, Cebu City, Davao City, Iloilo City and Cagayan de Oro; the cards show clean order rate, order issues, cancelled orders and GMV in PHP.
Each KPI is computed as a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so you can trace it to seller-day rows.
The issue-type chart separates issues that end in a cancellation from ones that always get resolved, such as weather-related courier disruptions.
tabs.call_out: Marketplace KPIs you can trace to source rows

transition.line: Which sellers need a health review first?

talking_points: A Snowflake ML classifier estimates, per seller, the chance of a cancelled order in the next 7 days.
Precision and recall come from the latest 14 days held out of training, shown next to the base rate.
Anomaly detection picks out unusual seller return rates, and the forecast covers the next 14 days of order issues.
tabs.call_out: ML that is evaluated honestly, next to the data

transition.line: Are sellers keeping their stock and documents in order?

persona.name: Andrea Villanueva
persona.role: Head of Marketplace Trust and Operations (fictional)

talking_points: Stock sync compliance, seller document coverage and pending documents show where controls are slipping.
Plotting stock sync compliance against cancelled orders per seller shows where the two move together; that is an association, not a cause.
The action memo proposes three prioritised actions using only the KPI, seller, issue-type and risk rows.
show: Stock sync compliance and document coverage
Stock sync compliance vs cancelled orders
tabs.call_out: Draft actions grounded in data, reviewed by a person

transition.line: What happens when an order hits a problem right now?

talking_points: New order events arrive in RAW.LIVE_ORDERS, either from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The alert records each ISSUE event with an SOP hint and the seller's risk band, then emails the on-call seller health analyst.
tabs.call_out: From a live order issue to a seller health case on one platform

persona.name: Andrea Villanueva
persona.role: Head of Marketplace Trust and Operations (fictional)

talking_points: The Cortex Agent answers metric questions with Cortex Analyst over the semantic view, and procedure questions with Cortex Search over 14 synthetic SOPs.
Every answer shows the SQL it generated and the SOP IDs it cited.
tabs.call_out: Answers in plain language that you can check
